title: Make direct fetch and PDF extraction production quality
description: Audit src/direct-transport.ts, src/fetcher.ts, src/pdf.ts, and extraction worker as the default individual-page path. Verify efficient Markdown/HTML/text/JSON handling, SSRF/redirect/cancellation/byte/deadline bounds, readable extraction fidelity, PDF text cleanup and explicit scanned/encrypted failures. Add representative fixtures and only add a new layer when it beats the current path. CLI/vision workflows remain outside the extension.

logs.msg: Audited direct fetch/PDF boundaries. Plain Markdown, text, JSON, and other non-HTML content now bypass the worker for lower overhead; worker postMessage failures clean up correctly. Added PDF empty-output, bounded-output/termination, and parser-diagnostic fixtures. SSRF, redirects, streamed byte bounds, cancellation, HTML extraction, Markdown, PDF, and YouTube tests plus typecheck pass.
